description: This file contains a Python implementation of a directed graph class 'Graph' used for managing devicetree node dependencies, including methods for adding nodes and edges, computing roots, and detecting strongly connected components via Tarjan's algorithm.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents a directed graph with nodes as edtlib Node objects, used to determine dependency order and detect cycles in devicetree node graphs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the graph, optionally with a root node.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Adds a node without edges to the graph.

methods.name: add_edge
methods.description: Adds a directed edge from source to target, adding nodes if necessary.

methods.name: roots
methods.description: Returns the set of root nodes with no incoming edges, caching the result.

methods.name: _tarjan
methods.description: Executes Tarjan's algorithm to find strongly connected components.

methods.name: _tarjan_root
methods.description: Performs Tarjan's algorithm starting from a specific node.

methods.name: scc_order
methods.description: Returns the list of strongly connected components in dependency order.

methods.name: depends_on
methods.description: Returns nodes that the given node directly depends on.

methods.name: required_by
methods.description: Returns nodes that directly depend on the given node.
